description: Aménagements cyclables is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération du Saint-Quentinois. Ensemble des aménagements cyclistes réalisées sur le territoire de l'agglomération du Saint-Quentinois. Piste cyclable Bande cyclable Voie verte Zones de rencontre piéton-cycliste Giratoire aménagé pour les vélos Stationnement vélo Zone 30. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération du Saint-Quentinois. The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération du Saint-Quentinois. Its keywords include velos, exception-zone-30, ca-de-saint-quentin, zone-de-rencontre, saint-quentin, pistes-cyclables. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GPKG. The listing shows 2026-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
